selection_reasoning: These two tasks form a natural multi-hop dependency chain. First, the agent must craft cobblestone into a cobblestone_wall using a crafting table. Then, the agent must mine (break) the cobblestone_wall block they just placed. This creates a clear sequential dependency: you cannot mine a cobblestone_wall unless one exists in the world, and crafting it is the prerequisite step. The crafting task requires cobblestone and a crafting table, while the mining task requires the output of the crafting task to be placed in the world. Both tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep Minecraft expertise — just basic crafting and block-breaking mechanics.

edges.reason: Mining a cobblestone_wall requires the agent to first craft cobblestone_wall from cobblestone at a crafting table, then place and break it

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted cobblestone_wall ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 cobblestone_wall, so any appearance confirms successful crafting. min_count=1 triggers as soon as the first wall is crafted from the crafting table output slot.

Uses inventory_has with min_count=6 because the recipe produces exactly 6 cobblestone_wall from 6 cobblestone. After crafting, the player takes all 6 from the output. To mine a cobblestone_wall, the player must first place one (reducing inventory to 5) then mine it back (returning to 6). Since milestone 1 can trigger at min_count=1 (when the player takes even 1 wall from crafting output), milestone 2 at min_count=6 ensures the player has completed the full craft-place-mine cycle: they took all 6 walls, placed at least one, and mined it back to restore the full count of 6.

scene_description: A cleared grass platform in a forest with a crafting table. The player has exactly 6 cobblestone in inventory (enough for one recipe producing 6 cobblestone_wall) and a stone pickaxe for mining. The player must use the crafting table to craft cobblestone_wall, then place one in the world and mine it back.
task_text: Use the crafting table to craft cobblestone into cobblestone_wall (place 6 cobblestone in the bottom two rows of the 3x3 grid). Then place a cobblestone_wall block on the ground and mine it with your stone pickaxe.
design_notes: 11x11 grass platform with air cleared above (including tree canopy layer). Crafting table at (~3, ~0, ~3) is within 5 blocks of spawn. Player has exactly 6 cobblestone (one recipe = 6 cobblestone_wall output). Stone pickaxe provided for mining. No extraneous blocks that could confuse the agent. The clearing provides ample space for placing and mining the crafted wall.
